terminals.name: api
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; cd backend && bun run dev
terminals.description: Hono API on http://localhost:3000. Needs OPENAI_API_KEY, ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY, and CLERK_SECRET_KEY as secrets to boot.

terminals.name: web
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; cd frontend && bun run dev
terminals.description: Next.js UI on http://localhost:8080. Needs NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY and CLERK_SECRET_KEY as secrets for auth.
